lede: Shrink JPG and PNG files or convert them to WebP. Add up to 30 images and see the real before and after size for each one.

faq.q: How much smaller will my images be?
faq.a: It depends on the image. Photos often get 50-80% smaller when exported as WebP at quality 0.8. PNG screenshots compress less, and an already heavily compressed file can occasionally grow - the tool shows the real result for every file.

faq.q: Can I compress many images at once?
faq.a: Yes, up to 30 images in one batch. They are processed one by one on your device, and you can save them individually or all at once.

faq.q: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Each image is decoded and re-encoded by your browser using Canvas. Nothing leaves your device.
